name.value: SureStay by Best Western Richmond Vancouver Airport

description.value: SureStay by Best Western Richmond Vancouver Airport is a mid-scale chain hotel on Westminster Highway in Richmond, positioned for quick access to Vancouver International Airport. The property includes complimentary breakfast and high-speed internet, and some rooms offer kitchen or kitchenette facilities, making it a practical base for multi-night stays. Richmond's dense restaurant corridor and proximity to the Fraser River delta make it a useful overnight stop for cyclists traveling the lower mainland.
